Evidence & scope

Distinct primary paper work or creator-defined benchmark family. Actual full primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-document scopes have exact author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews for every approved assertion. Initial first-peer-submitted drafts and the six original revise decisions remain preserved. Paper methods, current release versions, component tasks, and altered evaluation protocols are distinguished; no clinical accuracy, full payload recount, experiment reproduction, complete upstream rights clearance, worker employer/pay or supplier contribution is inferred beyond the cited explicit source statements. This metadata admission is not a frozen-core denominator decision.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

HealthBench · documents: The v1 paper describes HealthBench Consensus as 3,671 base examples with positive consensus criteria, drawn from 34 predefined criteria that are assigned only when more than half of raters and at least two physicians agree that they apply.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.healthbench.family.consensus-variation

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • This is a documented base-benchmark variation. It is not automatically credited as an additional independent family, nor does it imply that all base rubrics received the same consensus review.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

HealthBench · documents: The v1 paper selects HealthBench Hard by scoring base examples across five model providers, excluding examples with no positive score from any model, and taking the 1,000 examples with the lowest average score.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.healthbench.family.hard-variation-selection

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • This source-reported subset selection was not executed or independently replayed. It does not establish a separately authored dataset or resolve other HealthBench release identities.
